cases.question: Does Surface.premul_alpha() exist in pygame, in pygame-ce, or in both?
Is Surface.premul_alpha_ip() available in upstream pygame?
How can I tell at runtime whether I have pygame or pygame-ce installed?
cases.fact: pygame.IS_CE exists only in pygame-ce, since 2.1.4.

cases.question: Can I open two separate windows on screen at the same time?
cases.fact: pygame.Window, published in pygame-ce 2.5.2, drives multiple windows.

cases.question: I want to use pygame.geometry for circle collision. Is it available?
How do I add multiplayer networking to my pygame game?
cases.fact: Neither ships networking; the base does not cover it.
